details.description: Hermes 2 Pro on Mistral 7B is Nous Research's 7-billion-parameter chat model, an upgraded retrain of Nous Hermes 2 built on Mistral-7B-v0.1 and trained on a cleaned version of the OpenHermes 2.5 dataset plus new in-house function-calling and JSON-mode datasets, developed in partnership with Fireworks.AI. It uses the ChatML prompt format with a dedicated system-prompt structure for multi-turn function calling and structured JSON output. Nous Research has since released newer Hermes generations (Hermes 4 and Hermes 4.3) on Hugging Face.
advantages: Nous Research's dedicated function-calling evaluation (built with Fireworks.AI) reports 91% accuracy, per the model card's "Function Calling Accuracy: 91%" section.
The same evaluation suite reports 84% accuracy on structured JSON-mode output, per the model card.
Averages 71.19 on the GPT4All benchmark suite (arc_challenge, arc_easy, boolq, hellaswag, openbookqa, piqa, winogrande), per the model card.
disadvantages: Built on the original Mistral-7B-v0.1 base model; Nous Research has since released newer Hermes generations (Hermes 4, Hermes 4.3) on Hugging Face.
The model card's own tables show lower scores on more complex reasoning suites: AGIEval averages 44.52 and BigBench averages 41.65.
The model card states elsewhere that function-calling accuracy is 90%, a point lower than the 91% given in its dedicated evaluation section.
use_cases: Function calling and tool use in agentic applications
General multi-turn conversation and instruction-following via ChatML

sources.title: Hermes 2 Pro Mistral 7B API & Playground | Fireworks AI

notes: The model card itself is inconsistent: its intro prose states 90% function-calling accuracy while its dedicated 'Function Calling Accuracy: 91%' section states 91%; both are reported in the evaluations/notes. Catalog facts (32768 max input/output tokens, /v1/chat/completions) were not restated. Confirmed via the NousResearch org page that Nous Research has since shipped Hermes-4 and Hermes-4.3 model families (last modified Dec 2025/Jan 2026), making this March 2024 model an older generation, though the card itself carries no explicit deprecation notice. github_url left null: the only linked repo (NousResearch/Hermes-Function-Calling) is a tooling repo for the function-calling system, not the model's own repo.
